description.value: Thu Hien Deli is a Vietnamese specialty grocery and deli on Kingsway, in one of Vancouver's most concentrated Vietnamese commercial strips. The shop carries a broad range of Vietnamese packaged goods including cured meats (chả lụa, lạp xưởng), fresh noodles, fish sauces, snacks, and Vietnamese coffee. Touring cyclists passing through the area will find it a useful stop for shelf-stable provisions and prepared deli items.
